tools.name: gripp_list_companies
tools.description: List companies in Gripp. Companies (customers, suppliers, prospects) with address, VAT/COC numbers, customer number and active flag. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: company.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in Gripp. Contact persons with name, e-mail, phone, function and the company id. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: contact.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in Gripp. Projects with name, number, phase, company, account manager, dates, totals and archived flag. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: project.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in Gripp. Tasks with description, phase, deadline, estimated hours, company and completion state. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: task.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_hours
tools.description: List hours in Gripp. Time registrations (hours) with date, amount, employee, task, status and description. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: hour.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices in Gripp. Sales invoices with number, date, status, company, totals, amount paid and open amount. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: invoice.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_offers
tools.description: List offers in Gripp. Quotes (offers) with number, name, date, phase, company, totals and acceptance status. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: offer.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_employees
tools.description: List employees in Gripp. Employees with name, e-mail, function, department, role and active flag. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: employee.get.

tools.name: gripp_list_tags
tools.description: List tags in Gripp. Tags that Gripp uses to label companies, contacts, projects and invoices. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: tag.get.

tools.name: gripp_get_record
tools.description: Get one Gripp record by its numeric id, for companies, contacts, projects, tasks, hours, invoices, offers, employees or invoice lines. Gripp API: <entity>.getone.

tools.name: gripp_list_invoice_lines
tools.description: List invoice lines (description, amount, price, VAT) for one invoice id. Use this to see what an invoice contains. Gripp API: invoiceline.get.

tools.name: gripp_create_hour
tools.description: WRITE: register hours on a project (and optionally a task) in Gripp. Creates a new time registration each call; a repeat creates a duplicate. Status CONCEPT keeps it editable. Gripp API: hour.create.

tools.name: gripp_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task in Gripp. Creates a new task each call; a repeat creates a duplicate. Gripp API: task.create.

tools.name: gripp_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact person on a company in Gripp. Creates a new contact each call; a repeat creates a duplicate. Gripp API: contact.create.
